# Maya: AI Şef — AI recipe app (iOS, Turkish & English)

> Maya is a pocket AI chef for iPhone. Users photograph their fridge or list ingredients and get 2 personalized recipes in ~30 seconds, with hands-free step-by-step cooking mode and an AI chat. It also analyzes calories and macros from a photo of a plate. Free daily recipes; Premium unlocks unlimited generation; the weekly plan carries a 3-day free trial. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6749386118
